description.value: The Penny Farthing Pub is a well-established (est. 2001) Olde English-style pub in the heart of Victoria's Oak Bay Village, with four crackling fireplaces, Victorian-etched glass, and an extended patio where dogs and kids are welcome. It takes its name directly from the iconic 19th-century penny farthing bicycle and celebrates that era's whimsical, adventurous spirit through its decor and memorabilia. Part of a four-venue Victoria pub group, it serves modern British comfort food sourced from local land and sea.
